en.flavor: Hello, I am Kuki Shinobu, the deputy of the Arataki faction, the person in charge. If you find that our boss, Mr. Itto Arataki, has any inappropriate behavior outside, please feel free to contact me. this is my name card.  By Kuki Shinobu
en.firstNightReminder: Work as character he think is but except Outsider, and provide the info he supposed to receive but false. The Demon know what you doing at night.
